## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive (Healthcare, Energy, Consumer Staples, Materials, Communication). Defensive Consumer Staples and Healthcare are outperforming while Financials and Industrials show weekly weakness; Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 come from 3 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare lead: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: EOG (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +5.20%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +12.95%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +23.97%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -19.39%) BELOW TREND. Industrials soft: LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +2.38%) CORRECTION. Financials under pressure: JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership concentrated across Materials/Healthcare/Staples (3 sectors).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -7.16% | 1M: +1.23%) CORRECTION, LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +2.38%) CORRECTION, TJX (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -12.07%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials/Select Discretionary names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present among mega-caps (MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, AMZN (1W: -1.53% | 1M: +10.69%) CORRECTION) — tactical caution advised.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, under short-term pressure: AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: 9/24 positive — internal rotation and leadership narrowing.

8. Financials Outlook?
Weak this week with mixed pockets: V (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +5.73%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +9.49%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: 6/20 positive — Financials lag in the RISK-OFF tape.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive strength: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -7.90%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: 13/17 positive — Healthcare is a clear defensive leadership area.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor defensive and high-quality cyclicals: Consumer Staples and Healthcare exposure favored (EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND; MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to high-beta Tech and struggling Industrials/Financials until weekly trend confirms; monitor major-cap divergences (MSFT, NVDA, AMZN).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (13/17 positive) and Energy (8/10 positive) for defensive/cyclical strength. BEARISH: Technology (9/24 positive), Industrials (5/15 positive) and Utilities (2/10 positive) remain vulnerable — watch for further breadth deterioration.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: failure to reclaim this week's highs / close below weekly low would confirm CORRECTION momentum. AAPL: hold month-to-date lows to sustain RECOVERY. JPM: reclaim and hold recent monthly highs to remove CORRECTION risk. EL: sustain this week's breakout to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
EL (+55): Q4 earnings call signals higher margins; price confirming (EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND). LLY (+60): UK clears Foundayo / GLP‑1 advances; price confirming (LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-45): Labor/contract headlines adding pressure; price confirming downside (BA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +2.38%) CORRECTION). GM (-65): safety probe headline a notable catalyst; cross-check price (GM not in detailed view here) — monitor for SP100 impact and spillover into Autos/Industrial suppliers.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a Defensive/Value tilt. EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND and MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Major-cap divergences (MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION) and negative Industrial/Financial weekly breadth are the key risks to monitor.
